title: Anne O Probable NDE 4495
content: I was suffering with a contagious disease, scarlet fever; I was separated from my siblings in a bedroom apart from them. I remember it was close to Christmas and my mother described the Christmas tree and told me I will be well to enjoy the festivities, which will happen in a few days. I remember very little since I had a high fever, suddenly I felt my body sinking into the mattress and closing over me. Then I was looking down on a little girl lying in a fetal position on her right side. My mother was standing at the bottom of the bed. Suddenly I heard the front door opening and footsteps walking down the hall toward my bedroom. My father apparently went to see if he could find a doctor. He told my mother the doctor was unable to visit me and that he should take me to a hospital for contagious diseases, he had a taxi waiting for him. I didn't feel sad while looking at the scene, no feeling whatsoever. I then found myself in a very bright place, outdoors; I remember a very blue sky, and a large, bright gold gate with extending fence as far as I could see. There was a table in front of me with two people standing behind it, they looked at me then down at the table and told me I couldn't stay. There was no question about my destiny, I had no choice, and I understood. I then found myself in a French Speaking hospital several miles from my home where I stayed until I was well, about three months, when my parents were told to pick me up. I don't know if they knew my whereabouts, we never talked about it. I mentioned to my mother that I had an experience of leaving this world, or something to that effect, and described what I had seen. My mother told me never to tell anyone this story, I would never be believed and would look like a fool or a liar - I can't remember the exact words. I kept my secret until approximately ten years ago when I heard Art Bell on 'Coast to Coast AM' talking to people who had a similar experience. Mine was not quite like the others, there was no tunnel that I remember and can't remember seeing any other beings there.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt her body sinking into the mattress and closing over her.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two people standing behind a table in front of a large bright gold gate.

environment.environment_other_detail: Outdoors with a very blue sky; a large, bright gold gate with a fence extending as far as she could see; a table in front of her.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: OBE included observing parents discussing doctor/hospital; later found herself in a French-speaking hospital after being told she couldn't stay.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with observation of parents, then sudden arrival in bright outdoor place with gate and beings, then return to physical life in a hospital (no tunnel).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After being told she couldn't stay, she reports finding herself in a French-speaking hospital several miles from home and staying about three months; she later told her mother, who instructed her not to tell anyone.
